messages:
maria: Quick sync thread 1: topic choices narrowed to: 1) "Practical inference economics" 2) "Hybrid deployment patterns" 3) "Real-world fallbacks + reliability". leaning to a combined angle: econ + fallbacks. thoughts?
alex: vote for econ + fallbacks. it's the highest buyer signal.
divya: agree. we can weave a short case study about a mid-market SaaS cost drop. need someone to draft a 150-word abstract.
maria: i'll draft abstract A (econ + fallback narrative). will post draft by EOD Mon.
chris: speaker outreach status: ken -> confirmed for benchmarks, tam -> tentatively confirmed for demo, sunil -> panel. need a senior customer speaker; marc can you ping 2 POCs?
marc: pinged 2 customers this morning. one reply says yes for a short 6-min case slot. will confirm by Tue.
divya: slide deck plan: master deck owner = alex. each speaker uploads slides to /marketing/webinars/<event-id> by Thu noon. max 3 slides per speaker in the main deck.
alex: noted. will create deck and a slide template (title, 2 bullets, one visual).
maria: abstracts: we need two variants for landing page: short (1 line) + long (3 sentences). also one social copy (X/LinkedIn) 280 chars.
divya: i'll take social copy. maria you own landing variants.
chris: rehearsal timeline: speaker dry mic check 72h before, run-of-show rehearsal 24h before, final producer walk at 2h. sponsor ad check 4h before.
marc: ops note: ensure we have two producer accounts for rapid scene switching. also request a backup presenter who can step in for demo if tam is blocked.
maria: contingency: prerecorded 2-min demo + annotated timestamps to jump to clips. tam can make clip.
chris: run-of-show draft (compact):
00:00-03 intro + welcome (maria)
03-12 benchmarks & econ (ken)
12-25 live/demo + fallback clips (tam)
25-35 customer vignette (customer)
35-44 panel + product Qs (sunil, marc, ken)
44-50 live q&a & CTA close
marc: routing/registrations: high-intent tag = "demo-request" if form filled, auto-assign to SDR queue 1. low intent -> nurture 7d drip.
registrations-bot: automation note: form field mapping configured: email, company, title, intent. test mode on.
alex: one more ask: give panelists a 1-slide cheat sheet with 3 bullets and 2 suggested soundbites. can someone create a template?
divya: i'll create cheat sheet template and drop it in the deck folder.
maria: deadlines recap: abstracts + landing variants by EOD Tue, social copy by Wed morning, slides by Thu noon, rehearsal confirmations by Thu 9am. please confirm if you can meet these.
ken: confirmed.
tam: confirmed.
marc: confirmed subject to customer confirmation.
chris: confirmed.
registrations-bot: reminder scheduled: abstract due alert 48h before deadline.
maria: thanks team 1 I'll lock topic and start draft outreach mail to registrants. will post back with landing copy link.
